originalTitle: Tim Cook says ‘I’m not meddling’ in the new Apple CEO’s business

content: Tim Cook stepped down as Apple CEO in September, handing over the top job to former hardware chief John Ternus and taking an executive chairman role. Cook’s still a visible representative of the company, having been recently photographed attending a state dinner at the White House. But in an interview with The Independent, Cook says he’s “not meddling” in Ternus’ work. “First of all, John and I have an incredible level of trust in each other,” Cook said. “The relationship must be based on trust, and the communication must be frequent and significant. But other than that, what I’m focused on right now is worldwide policy. And the interface with governments around the world matters because there are lots of things where we’re trying to advance or advocate for change. There’s a significant amount of work in that, and I’m doing that and helping John in any way he sees fit. I’m not meddling. I’m not a meddler.” Cook also said he’s told Ternus to “make it your own job. Put your time in the things that you can add the most value to around the company. And that means don’t mimic me. Just like I didn’t mimic Steve. We all have different strengths.” (Ternus told staff that, based on advice from Cook, “I need to spend my time where I can add the most value for Apple,” Bloomberg recently reported.) In the interview, Cook discussed how he wanted to make the leadership transition to Ternus “the best transition ever, a textbook example that people could look back to and learn from.” The transition “actually started years ago,” according to Cook, and he said that “I think everything has gone sort of exactly the way I had envisioned it.” Ternus introduced the iPhone Duo just days after taking over, and Cook said that he “wanted John to have some wind at his back.”
chineseTitle: 蒂姆·库克表示“我不会干涉”苹果新任首席执行官的业务
chineseSummary: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 于 9 月辞去苹果首席执行官一职，将最高职位移交给前硬件首席执行官约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus)，并担任执行董事长一职。库克仍然是该公司的知名代表，最近被拍到出席白宫国宴。但在接受《独立报》采访时，库克表示 [...]
chineseContent: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 于 9 月辞去苹果首席执行官一职，将最高职位移交给前硬件首席执行官约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus)，并担任执行董事长一职。库克仍然是该公司的知名代表，最近被拍到参加白宫国宴。但库克在接受《独立报》采访时表示，他“没有干涉”特努斯的工作。 “首先，约翰和我彼此之间有着令人难以置信的信任，”库克说。 “这种关系必须建立在信任的基础上，沟通必须频繁且重要。但除此之外，我现在关注的是全球政策。与世界各国政府的互动也很重要，因为我们在很多事情上试图推进或倡导变革。这方面的工作量很大，我正在做这件事，并以约翰认为合适的任何方式帮助他。我不会干涉。我不是爱管闲事的人。”库克还表示，他告诉特纳斯“把它当作你自己的工作。把你的时间放在能为公司带来最大价值的事情上。这意味着不要模仿我。就像我没有模仿史蒂夫一样。我们都有不同的优势。” （据彭博社最近报道，Ternus 告诉员工，根据库克的建议，“我需要把时间花在能为苹果增加最大价值的地方。”）在采访中，库克讨论了他希望如何将领导层过渡到 Ternus，“这是有史以来最好的过渡，一个人们可以回顾和学习的教科书例子。”库克表示，这种转变“实际上在几年前就开始了”，他说“我认为一切都按照我的设想进行”。 Ternus 接手几天后就推出了 iPhone Duo，库克表示，他“希望约翰能得到一些支持”。
